shiftIntro: We use AI tools every day, and we enjoy them. AI is a democratized technology. Everyone has it, so on its own it gives no one an edge. It accelerates whatever tendencies an organization already has. So know your competitive advantage first, and then amplify it through strategic AI adoption. Resist sprinkling AI over old structures in a rush just because AI vendors spread FOMO.
Below are the shifts that organizations wanting sustainable quality, real customer value and high adaptability make.

shifts.note: Enabling product engineers to shift from narrow, assembly-line specialists to end-to-end craftspeople — with AI filling the specialist gaps and offering upskilling for entering new domains.

Instead of coordinating fragments through handoffs and integration meetings, complete craftspeople work in flow with their agents and with each other, alternating between focused work and looking at the whole product together, improving it as a whole.

Moving product engineers from coding features one by one to designing the agentic systems that build them — self-improving loops that turn intent into tested, working software and verify every change against tests and specs, while product engineers own the tests and the value loop.

Ending the telephone game through manager-proxies and the era of “IT sitting in the basement” — instead putting product engineers at zero distance with the customers and users, to empathize, analyze, and synthesize firsthand.
Elevating product engineers from counting output to owning the complete value loop — ensuring real customer impact, experimenting and course-correcting as the evidence comes in.

Organizing around value instead of around existing roles and team boundaries — product engineers move to where the most valuable work is as priorities shift, which keeps the whole organization adaptable.

use: These shifts are not a checklist. Not every organization needs all six, and not all to the same depth. Which ones matter, and how far you take each one, depends on your product, your customers and the competitive advantage you want to build.

Use them as inspiration to define your strategy. Pick the shifts that strengthen your advantage, decide how far to go with each, and only then choose where AI amplifies them. Revisit the mix as you learn. That is how you own the agentic shift and make it happen on your terms.
